competency_fulfillment.rationale: 13 of 15 samples ask students to compute a total from given pieces, matching "Determine and write the value", but seeds 55 and 500 invert the task ("Use coins and bills to make exactly ₱125" / "₱801"), which is a construction task, not a determination of a given set's value.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Of 15 samples, centavo-coins-only is named with specific denominations in 5 (seeds 42, 43, 46, 72, 604), peso-coins-only in 4 (44, 601, 602, 603), and peso-bills-only in 3 (45, 501, 502); the fourth sub-case, "combined peso coins and peso bills", never appears with named denominations of both a coin and a bill together, only the generic phrase "coins and bills" in seeds 50, 55, and 500 with no denomination breakdown.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Phrasing stays to a single short sentence per item and the arithmetic is one addition step over 2-4 same-type denominations (e.g. "6 50¢ coins and 2 25¢ coins"), consistent with a grade 2 quarter 2 money-counting unit.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: 12 of the 15 samples open with the identical template "What is the total value of", and seeds 42 and 46 are the exact same question text and correct_answer (350) with only the option order shuffled, leaving thin phrasing/context variety outside of the single read_mcq visual item (seed 50).

competency_alignment.rationale: Across formatters (mcq, cloze, read_mcq, set_fill_in_blank) the varying elements are denomination type (centavo coins vs peso coins vs peso bills) and monetary magnitude, both of which are the axes the competency itself names, not an unrelated skill.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Correct answers span from 6 (seed 44) up to 1000 (seed 501, "What is the total value of 2 ₱500 bills?"), so the peso-denominated items reach the competency's stated ₱1000 ceiling rather than stopping short of it.
